# SynCine

> Real-Time P2P Synchronized Cinema Platform

SynCine is a web-based collaborative cinema and video synchronization platform engineered for low-latency group viewing.

## Core Features
- Full Mesh WebRTC: Encrypted browser-to-browser media transmission strictly capped at 4 peers per room.
- Sub-350ms Drift Compensation: Real-time latency benchmarking and playback synchronization engine.
- Dual Streaming Modes: Hardware-accelerated screen casting (H.264) and client-side local video file synchronization.
- Privacy First: Zero server-side video transcoding, caching, or cloud storage.
- Ephemeral Lifecycle: Guest watchrooms automatically reset after a 3-hour buffer; optional Appwrite accounts provide permanent vanity rooms.

## Technology Stack
- Frontend: React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, WebRTC API, Web Audio API
- Backend & Signaling: Appwrite Cloud (Databases, Realtime, Document-Level Security, Auth)
- Synchronization: Custom discrete-seek and micro-rate drift correction algorithm
